name: Victory
description: The level-up figure taken further: the same four rungs at a slower step and a longer note, then the top two struck again so it ends on the octave rather than merely reaching it. One phrase, six notes.
offBand: Under the fanfare band on purpose, and level with ss.sfx.levelup. Despite the name it is not heard once a run: every chest, every awakening and every time stop opens on it, so at the level of a once-a-run fanfare it is the loudest thing those moments make.
